    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">使用 Windows 的子系统 WSL 安装 Ubuntu 22.04</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>博客地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/zylyehuo/</a></p>
</blockquote>
<h1 id="第一步安装-wsl">第一步、安装 WSL</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>以管理员身份打开 PowerShell</p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228151135586-556834978.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code>PS C:\WINDOWS\system32&gt; wsl --install
</code></pre>
<h1 id="第二步重启电脑">第二步、重启电脑</h1>
<h1 id="第三步安装-ubuntu-2204">第三步、安装 Ubuntu 22.04</h1>
<pre><code>PS C:\WINDOWS\system32&gt; wsl --set-default-version 2
</code></pre>
<pre><code>PS C:\WINDOWS\system32&gt; wsl --install -d ubuntu-22.04
</code></pre>
<h1 id="第四步输入用户名">第四步、输入用户名</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228151515967-198811545.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="第五步输入密码">第五步、输入密码</h1>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228151832941-1378934734.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228151912082-154463914.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="第六步安装-ros2">第六步、安装 ROS2</h1>
<pre><code>zylyehuo@LAPTOP-4FQQUA1G:~$ wget http://fishros.com/install -O fishros &amp;&amp; bash fishros
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>选择 1</p>
</blockquote>

<h1 id="第七步更新环境目录">第七步、更新环境目录</h1>
<pre><code>zylyehuo@LAPTOP-4FQQUA1G:~$ source  ~/.bashrc
</code></pre>
<h1 id="第八步测试是否安装成功">第八步、测试是否安装成功</h1>
<pre><code>zylyehuo@LAPTOP-4FQQUA1G:~$ ros2
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228154947900-545475586.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="第九步运行小海龟例程">第九步、运行小海龟例程</h1>
<pre><code>zylyehuo@LAPTOP-4FQQUA1G:~$ ros2 run turtlesim turtlesim_node
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228155204536-1938066410.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<pre><code># 新开一个终端（PowerShell）
zylyehuo@LAPTOP-4FQQUA1G:~$ wsl
</code></pre>
<pre><code>zylyehuo@LAPTOP-4FQQUA1G:~$ ros2 run turtlesim turtle_teleop_key
</code></pre>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3071480/202512/3071480-20251228155543284-1898599353.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
